defect: The generated clock is attached to the divider register's D input instead of its Q output.
rationale: The datapath is clocked by slow_clk, which is produced from the divider state. A generated clock on count_d does not describe the clock waveform observed at the divider output and can leave the real generated-clock pin unconstrained.

mutation.description: Attached create_generated_clock to the divider's combinational D signal rather than the divided clock Q/output pin.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: The generated clock targets count_d, an unused combinational next-bit signal. The actual clock driving the datapath is clk_o from count_q[2]. The actual clock is also divide-by-eight rather than the stated divide-by-two.
